item.coloph: dbal chen rngam pa'i thugs rgyud/ stag la me 'bar gyi thugs dam/ bla chen dran pa'i lung don/ stang chen dmu tsa'i snying gtam/ 'od ldan 'bar ma'i snyan rgyud/ de ltar gsang sngags kyis (kyi) gnad don 'di/ yum cig 'od ldan 'bar ma'i/ gnas mchog dam pa shel le rdzong drug du/ dus mtha'i rnal 'byor mi shig rdo rje rtsal/ nges med sprang po bdag la snyan chadu brgyud/ bdag gis sbas dang gsang rgya thub par byas/ mtshan ldan bla ma dam pa ste/ zhu g.yas (yas) bsod nams dbang ldan grags pa'i(pas/)yang yang bskal ma byas nas su/ bka' rnam par dag pa'i yi ge 'di/ ri khyad 'phags spu rgyal gang zang(gangs bzang) zhol/ mtsho gling rgya mtsho 'khyil ba'i mdun zhol su (du/)dkar chab (chag) yi ge ris su bris pa pa 'di/ yi dam rig 'dzin rnams la mthol lobashags/ bka' skyongs bsrung (srung) ma rnams la bzod par gsol/ dge bas 'gro kun rig 'dzin sa thob shog/
